lines.t: Looking in the mirror, I see a stranger's face
Heavy heart and empty hands, trying to find my place
I've wandered too long in shadows, grown numb and cold.
The thirst I can't deny is digging through my soul.
Am I chasing the truth or just hiding from the pain?
Can I lay down my pride?
Let love break these chains.
I need something real to fill this hollow in my chest
Longing for a fire that'll burn away the rest
If I say I love you, I whoosh you more than everything I own
Why do I wrestle? Why do I run along?
You love me first, I hear it in the quiet night
Every scar and broken promise held within your light
I open up my longing, let hunger flood my bones
Waiting for my heart to move, to make your love my home
Obedience is the answer
Love perfected by the test
I stumble and I tremble
But I'm giving all my best
I need something real to fill this hollow in my chest
Longing for a fire that'll burn away the rest
If I say I love Yahushua more than everything I own
Keep pressing me inside
Till your fruit in me is grown
Break me and remake me
Spirit lead my wandering feet
Let every step I take
Be a song that rises sweet
I need something real to fill this hollow in my chest
Longing for a revelation until nothing of me's left
If I say I love Yahushua more than every breath I've known
Let hunger and obedience prove the seeds that I have sown.
